heroHeading: A family in timber since the 1940s
heroText: More than 80 years of sawmilling and pallet manufacturing experience, now behind Thorpe Timbers in Ngome.

today.heading: Thorpe Timbers today
paragraphs: Thorpe Timbers is a plantation pine and eucalyptus sawmill in Ngome, KwaZulu-Natal. We produce structural timber, pallet material and CCA treated poles, along with by-products such as firewood, sawdust and shavings, so that very little of each log goes to waste.
The business was previously called Ngomi Timbers. The name has changed; the people, the mill and the way we work have not.
We are a growing team with growing capacity, and we are proud to provide local employment and to build long-term relationships with customers and suppliers across KZN.
